title: The Turn of the Screw
author: Henry James
summary: A young governess takes charge of two orphaned children at a remote country house. She comes to believe that the ghosts of two former servants are trying to claim the children.
readIf: you like old-fashioned ghost stories that leave you debating whether the haunting is real.
skipIf: you want a clear answer and a modern, direct style.

pairings.reason: Another story where the line between ghost and mind is deliberately blurred.
A young woman in an imposing house, haunted by someone else's past.
An isolated house, a narrator we cannot fully trust, and a creeping unease.
